1.Description: Magical energy as pure as moonlight surges within. It can be smelted down and used to level up the legendary sword, the Solemn Vow. Apprentices can acquire Erudite Essence by completing Mentor and Learning Tasks.

2.Description: Bearing witness to both blood and fire, it is the ultimate symbol of Mentor and Apprentice. Mentors can acquire Mentorship Points by helping their Apprentices level up.
